Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the intro last week. We'd like to set up a technical deep-dive with your infra team to review Dedicated GPU capacity sizing, autoscaling behavior, and tenant isolation for our expected workload. Goal is to validate that Dedicated will meet our latency and compliance requirements before we finalize the reserved capacity commit.

Attendees on our side: Alex Johnson (Technical Lead), Sita Rao (Cloud Architect), Procurement. We're targeting mid-next-week. Do you have 60-90 minute slots on Tue/Wed (Mar 2-3) PST?

Appreciate it — Alex

Agenda (60–75 min):
- 10 min intro / objectives
- 25 min pool sizing & autoscaling strategy (workload profiles, concurrency, warm vs cold slots) — Dev
- 20 min isolation & network controls (VM/GPU isolation, tenancy, KMS/keys, audit logs) — Rishi
- 10–15 min Q&A + procurement questions
